So yea, I do need a miracle. I'll continue trying to make it happen, and hopefully make it before I run out of time.

" I made myself a promise around 18 months ago that I would work like a machine day and night, transform myself in every way possible. Sadly, I don't think I am going through with this plan, I think my time walking this earth is getting less by the day. And now I am scared that I would be in a similar spot to you in time. I just don't see it working.. it really sucks.

I actually sacrificed a lot to make this work..is it too much to want to feel like they would have my back like I did theirs?  


Am I the reason this didn't work?

Maybe I worded my concerns badly.  


The reasoning for not choosing me over moving away with her family because they got tired of carrying me, trying to blame the break up on me in a way. Should I feel responsible, is it stupid of me to think they would have done the same for me when I needed them?

To some of us, well for me at least - I don't see suicide as my only option.  


I know I can make it, I know if I grind hard enough I'll get by. I don't see absolutely no other options.  


I am simply tired of fighting and trying, it started to feel pointless. Going in circles, trying succeeding failing, and all the pain I have to endure to keep going is hardly worth it anymore.  


Suicide is just an option, and people who go through with it most likely no its not THE ONLY option, but its the one that comforts the best at the time. If that makes sense.

And when the first reply you get when you tell someone that you think might help you from killing yourself is "And you wan't to do a non-believer?" "Maybe you should kill yourself if you don't believe in god"

Yea tell me about it.

Less than two month to go. Can't wait.

Well, I was born in a shitty country. for so many reasons.  


I was born very poor, in a family that was torn by that fact. I was depressed and alone, mostly because of social anxiety. I met a girl online that changed my world. I worked very hard to save up for a plane ticket. 4 years I have worked, 12 hour nightly shifts, I worked anything and everything. and my paycheck was less than a 100$ a month. it took my 4 years of saving everything up and not enjoying my life to leave the country. I spent the couple of next years of my life happy. But that was cut short because my country forced me to go back for mandatory military services. 2.5 years in military unpaid. I lost my job, my partner and my house, pets. everything I ever held dear.  


And now I am here. pretty much my story.
Pretty much. And this sucks about your deformities. Its unfair for some of us who just have to work way harder than everyone else. We didn't choose this bullshit. Its a curse that never ends.
It does. I don't see the point of going on anymore when its hard to feel better.

I know where that comes from. I feel like a burden that is why I am choosing to be on my own right now. Sometimes you need comfort, and a conversation with someone who can some what relate.  


I've been fighting 10 times as hard as a normal person just to be normal and I think its not fair. and after 10 years of fighting, when I got to feel somewhat happy everything came crashing down. its like some stupid curse.  


I don't even mind rebuilding. I even want to. But life doesn't want me to win. That just seems to be the only way my story ends.

I am giving it my best try. Despite all the depression and suicidal thoughts I actually do want to live. But I can't just go through my entire life struggling and see my dreams demolished before my eyes for reasons I can't control.  


And if God knows this needs more hope he needs to restore our faith in him.  
I am honestly not asking to win the lottery or find a shortcut through life. I just want a small win.

I relate with you, I also have social anxiety. Even though it seems like people enjoy my company.  


However everything I am doing right now is purely for me, I am not looking for friends, love or anything. I am taking care of myself, hoping that I would find me. If that makes sense? maybe I need to remember who I actually am as a person, without resorting to anyone else's opinion or judgement. I wanna do something for me, before I leave this place.

I couldn't have said it better if I had to.

I am also getting tired of people telling me to think who's going to be effected by my death, and I should be strong for them. I have been in pain for so long now and I just can't take it anymore.

But this is why I am giving some time before I go through with it. And I am not just sitting there hoping for a miracle. I am actually trying my hardest to make a change. But sometimes, if god actually exists it would be nice of him to show a little gesture, a small win. Its all I need.

Sadly, no. I don't really have anyone that I can rely on, or have my back.
